verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਨ ਸੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਸਬ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਚਕਵੀ ਬਿਓਗ ਸੋਗ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise rain sain samai sab log mai sa(n)jog bhog chakavee biog sog bhaagaheen jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as everyone enjoys the company of their dear ones at night, but a ruddy sheldrake is considered unfortunate having been separated from its beloved.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਉਲੂ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਪਰਚੀਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhinakar kai udhot jot jagamag uloo a(n)dh ka(n)dh paracheen unamaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as sunrise brightens up the place but an owl is seen hidden in dark allays and walls.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦਰ ਜਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਰਹਤ ਬਕਬਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: saravar saritaa samu(n)dhar jal pooran hai tirakhaava(n)t chaatirak rahat bakabaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Ponds, streams and oceans are seen to be full to the brim with water, but longing for rain, a rain-bird remains thirsty and keeps wailing and crying for that Swati drop.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਅਪਰਾਧਨ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਐ ॥੫੦੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise mil saadhasa(n)g sakal sa(n)saar tario moh aparaadhee aparaadhan bihaaneeaai ||509||

en.bdb: Similarly by associating themselves with the congregation of the True Guru, the whole world is sailing across the worldly ocean but I, the sinner is spending all his life in evil deeds and vices.  (509)
